about: The postcommunio of the formulary “13th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Lord, having received the heavenly mysteries, we pray that we may advance toward a fuller share in eternal redemption. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, forever and ever.

a.g: we pray that we may advance toward a fuller share in eternal redemption
